intro.text: A farming town in southeastern Shinovar, where Szeth grew up.

description.text: Clearmount stands near the southern coast in the Nirovah Valley. Sheep graze the surrounding grasslands, and the nearby coast is vulnerable to raids.

items.text: Szeth's family lived on a homestead about an hour's walk from town. They visited Clearmount for monthly devotions, and his mother taught painting there.
The family left the homestead to live at the Stoneward monastery.
Szeth and Kaladin visited the old homestead while investigating the troubles in Shinovar.
